findings.title: Observer cleanup discards other projects’ polling state
findings.description: `RunnerTenant` shares one observer across projects, but each `observe()` deletes cached state for every entry outside the current project. Reproduced A → B → A at an unchanged clock: A was polled twice despite the 15-second interval. This also destroys overdue/fault tracking and least-recently-polled ordering. Scope cleanup per project or maintain separate observers.

findings.title: Launch can begin after the budget expires
findings.description: The budget check precedes journal creation and commit; `launch()` then starts the child without rechecking. Reproduced a journal operation advancing time beyond the deadline: launch still began and returned `COMPLETE`. A stop arriving during journaling has the same problem. Recheck immediately before spawning, with explicit handling of the journaled-but-not-launched entry.

findings.title: Unconfirmed launch faults disappear between polls
findings.description: After a poll failure, `_fault()` caches the fault, but the unconfirmed path never replays it while waiting for the next poll. Reproduced consecutive ticks changing from `FAULT` with one fault to `LAUNCHING` with none, without a successful observation. `ProjectTick._close_recovered()` consequently closes the escalation prematurely. Preserve the standing fault until a subsequent observation clears it.
